title: Gate 2 read-only dependency fan-in design
purpose: Freeze the minimal canonical bounded design for Gate 2 read-only dependency fan-in above the accepted Gate 1 sequential queue, without activating Gate 2, changing Gate 0/Gate 1 runtime, enabling repository-write jobs, or enabling parallel execution.
invariants: This work package is design-only and does not authorize Gate 2 runtime implementation or activation.
Gate 0 and all tools/ai_jobs runtime implementation remain read-only for OPS-WP-008.
A Gate 2 dependency is bound by job_id, immutable request_comment_id, request_sha256 and target_sha under one exact graph scope; job_id alone is never sufficient.
Gate 2 V1 fan-in is strict AND: every direct predecessor must have durable valid success evidence before a descendant becomes runnable.
Only a Gate 1 COMPLETED terminal plus a durable Gate 2 binding to the exact authoritative Gate 0 outcome comment body satisfies a dependency.
Outcome comment_id alone is insufficient; the exact UTF-8 outcome body SHA-256 is mandatory and the existing Gate 0 inner cryptographic/schema validation must still pass.
FAILED, stale, ambiguous, deleted, edited or invalidated predecessors never satisfy descendants.
A blocked or receipt-reconciling graph is not an empty queue and must not be automatically closed as empty.
The V1 graph is static and bounded to one repository, one authority issue, one request issue, one session and one generation; cross-session and cross-generation references are forbidden.
Among multiple runnable nodes, existing Gate 1 deterministic order by request_comment_id then job_id remains authoritative.
Gate 2 edges carry eligibility only and never predecessor stdout, artifacts, generated code or outcome data into descendant request parameters.
The accepted Gate 1 JOB_STARTED to RECOVERY_REQUIRED boundary and zero automatic replay are preserved.

After durable JOB_SELECTED and before JOB_STARTED, Gate 2 must freshly reconstruct the exact graph/digest, session/generation, descendant source request, every direct predecessor, unique Gate 1 terminal, valid Gate 2 receipt, authoritative Gate 0 outcome and exact outcome body SHA-256 from stable GitHub reads.
After durable JOB_STARTED and immediately before any Gate 0 invocation, the same complete Gate 2 dependency-truth reconstruction must run again from fresh stable GitHub reads.

A previous RUNNABLE projection, Gate 1 final_effect_guard() alone, or a previously observed receipt without rereading its terminal and bound authoritative outcome is never sufficient at either privileged boundary.

Dependency invalidation before JOB_STARTED prevents JOB_STARTED and Gate 0; invalidation or unstable/ambiguous truth after durable JOB_STARTED but before effect requires RECOVERY_REQUIRED with zero Gate 0 invocation and zero automatic replay.
requiredEvidence: Exact changed-path inventory contains only docs/operations/GATE2_FANIN_DESIGN.md and work-packages/OPS-WP-008.json.
OPS-WP-008.json passes tools/validate_repository.py on the exact design head.
Independent contradictory review covers dependency identity, strict AND fan-in, durable outcome-body binding, BLOCKED versus EMPTY, bounded DAG rejection, recovery and security-profile separation.
Independent review confirms no runtime, Gate 0, workflow, product, Gate 3 or Gate 4 path changed.
Any future runtime implementation must rerun the full existing Gate 1 tests with zero skip/xfail camouflage and the unchanged Gate 0 regression suite.
G2-QA-013-F01 correction is present normatively at both privileged timing boundaries and the old QA binding to 5a8c542c675d72f11a7f250ab58c5a2c3cbbf4f3 is invalidated pending exact-head QA rebind.

Independent QA explicitly mutates or deletes predecessor receipt/outcome authority after JOB_SELECTED and again after durable JOB_STARTED, and proves the required no-start/no-effect recovery semantics.

Independent QA proves unstable or ambiguous GitHub reads at either privileged boundary fail closed and that a stale RUNNABLE projection, final_effect_guard() alone, or cached receipt truth cannot authorize continuation.
adversarialTests: Reject a dependency that supplies only job_id.
Reject duplicate node job_id, request_comment_id or request_sha256 identities.
Reject duplicate dependency edges.
Reject direct self-cycles and indirect cycles deterministically.
Reject missing references and every cross-repository, cross-authority, cross-request-issue, cross-session or cross-generation reference.
Reject graphs exceeding 65536 canonical payload bytes, 32 nodes, 64 edges, fan-in 8, fan-out 16 or depth 8.
Prove a descendant is runnable only when every direct predecessor is SATISFIED.
Prove FAILED, STALE_BEFORE_EXECUTION, STALE_AFTER_EXECUTION and AMBIGUOUS_HOLD never satisfy an edge.
Prove COMPLETED without a durable outcome-binding receipt remains BINDING_PENDING.
Mutate an authoritative outcome body while retaining its comment_id and prove the body-digest binding fails closed.
Delete or edit a predecessor request, outcome, graph or receipt and prove no descendant execution is authorized.
Prove a graph containing only blocked descendants is not automatically closed as empty.
Prove simultaneously runnable nodes preserve Gate 1 request_comment_id then job_id election order.
Prove no predecessor stdout, artifact, code, summary or outcome field can alter descendant Gate 0 request bytes.
Crash after durable JOB_STARTED and prove RECOVERY_REQUIRED with zero automatic replay.
Crash after terminal COMPLETED before receipt and prove receipt reconciliation occurs without re-executing Gate 0.
Create divergent receipt candidates for one predecessor and prove ambiguity causes hold rather than election by convenience.
Kill mutants that weaken AND to OR, remove body SHA binding, accept blocked as empty, ignore a cycle edge, allow cross-generation references or order by graph position.
After durable JOB_SELECTED, edit/delete a predecessor receipt or bound Gate 0 outcome and prove no JOB_STARTED is published and no Gate 0 invocation occurs.
After durable JOB_STARTED but before Gate 0 effect, edit/delete a predecessor receipt or bound Gate 0 outcome and prove RECOVERY_REQUIRED, zero Gate 0 invocation and zero automatic replay.
Make either privileged-boundary GitHub read unstable or non-unique and prove fail-closed behavior.
Keep Gate 1 final_effect_guard() green while invalidating Gate 2 predecessor truth and prove Gate 0 still cannot be invoked.
Reuse a previously valid Gate 2 receipt object without rereading its terminal and authoritative outcome and prove the privileged-boundary revalidation rejects that shortcut.
nonGoals: Implementing or activating Gate 2 runtime behavior.
Changing the accepted Gate 0 request, execution, outcome or publication implementation.
Redesigning the accepted Gate 1 session, ledger, election, crash-recovery or effect-boundary semantics.
Adding repository-write jobs, branch/commit/push/workflow-dispatch/merge/release/promotion capability or any Gate 3 behavior.
Adding runtime parallelism or any Gate 4 behavior.
Adding dataflow, templating, dynamic request generation, output substitution, optional dependencies, OR fan-in, quorum fan-in or a generic workflow language.
Allowing cross-session, cross-generation, cross-authority or cross-repository dependency graphs in V1.
Claiming FULL_V6_SECURITY for the current GATE1_PILOT_READ_ONLY trust profile.
independentReview: Independent QA must review the exact design head and must not repair the two design-author paths while acting as reviewer.
Review must challenge all closed contract fields, bounds and deterministic rejection order rather than accepting narrative intent.
Review must explicitly attack outcome comment mutation because comment_id alone is not an immutable content binding.
Review must prove that blocked-only and binding-pending states cannot fall through to the current Gate 1 empty-close path.
Review must challenge cross-session and cross-generation aliasing, duplicate identities, direct/indirect cycles and no-dataflow enforcement.
Review must keep OWNER-G2-SEC-01 open and must not silently decide whether Gate 2 read-only continuation requires FULL_V6_SECURITY.
A passing design review does not authorize implementation, activation, merge, Gate 3 or Gate 4.
G2-QA-013-F01 from QA comment 5434977332 was accepted by governor correction comment 5435953252; the corrected design requires exact-head rebind and a full QA oracle rerun.
The two privileged timing-window probes are mandatory QA evidence: after JOB_SELECTED/before JOB_STARTED and after durable JOB_STARTED/immediately before Gate 0.

designDecisions.dependencyIdentity: job_id + request_comment_id + request_sha256 + target_sha under the exact repository/authority/request-issue/session/generation graph scope
designDecisions.satisfyingPredecessor: Gate 1 terminal COMPLETED plus durable valid Gate 2 outcome-binding receipt
designDecisions.outcomeBinding: authoritative Gate 0 comment_id plus SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 comment body, with existing Gate 0 inner validation
designDecisions.blockedVsEmpty: BLOCKED, RECONCILING, RECOVERY_REQUIRED and GLOBAL_HOLD are not empty; only COMPLETE is autonomously exhaustible
designDecisions.graphModel: static bounded DAG fixed before first execution
designDecisions.boundary: same repository, authority issue, request issue, session and generation only
designDecisions.crashRecovery: preserve Gate 1 JOB_STARTED -> RECOVERY_REQUIRED and zero automatic replay
designDecisions.preEffectDependencyRevalidation: mandatory complete fresh stable-GitHub reconstruction at both privileged boundaries: after durable JOB_SELECTED before JOB_STARTED, and after durable JOB_STARTED immediately before Gate 0; cached RUNNABLE/receipt truth and Gate 1 final_effect_guard() alone are insufficient
designDecisions.preStartInvalidation: no JOB_STARTED and no Gate 0 invocation; BLOCKED or GLOBAL_HOLD according to the existing invalidation model
designDecisions.postStartPreEffectInvalidation: RECOVERY_REQUIRED, zero Gate 0 invocation, zero automatic replay

ownerDecisionsOpen: OWNER-G2-SEC-01: decide under a separate runtime authority whether dependency-triggered autonomous continuation may use an explicitly limited GATE2_PILOT_READ_ONLY profile or whether FULL_V6_SECURITY is required before Gate 2 activation.
rollback: Close the draft design PR without merge, or revert only docs/operations/GATE2_FANIN_DESIGN.md and work-packages/OPS-WP-008.json if this design is withdrawn. Gate 0, Gate 1 runtime and all durable GitHub evidence remain unchanged.

qaCorrection.scope: Normative complete Gate 2 dependency-truth revalidation at both privileged timing boundaries only; no runtime implementation.
